senses.gloss: वंश m. 1. A bamboo, स्फुटति पटुनिनादः शुष्कवंशस्थलीषु Rt.i.25, Megh.ii.16; 2. a race, a family, a lineage, a dynasty, क्व सूर्यप्रभवो वंशः क्व चाल्पविषया मतिः R.i.2, ii.33, Megh.i.6; 3. an assemblage, a multitude, R.iii.39; 4. a staff; 5. a joint; 6. the sāla tree; 7. a sort of sugarcane; 8. a flute, a pipe; 9. the backbone; 10. a particular measure of length equal to ten hastas.

वंचक (I) a. (f. चिका) 1. Deceiving, cheating; 2. fraudulent, crafty.
